items.headline: Woman, 68, slashed in Sheepshead Bay subway door dispute
items.blurb: A 68-year-old woman was slashed after an argument over a subway door in Sheepshead Bay, police said.

items.headline: Man shot in leg in car near Bed-Stuy school; students shelter in place
items.blurb: A man sitting in a car near Monroe Street and Ralph Avenue was shot in the leg, police said. A nearby school sheltered in place; no students were hurt.

items.headline: Four men beat driver with pipe and steal his SUV in East Williamsburg
items.blurb: A 27-year-old driver was hit with a metal pipe and punched on Ten Eyck Street before four men drove off in his SUV. Police released images of the suspects.

items.headline: Teenager slashed in Queens morning assault; young suspect still at large
items.blurb: A teenager was slashed in a morning attack in Queens on Monday, and police said the young suspect fled and remained on the run.

items.headline: Fresh Meadows man indicted on hate crime charges over kosher bagel shop vandalism
items.blurb: A 22-year-old man was indicted on criminal mischief as a hate crime, accused of twice knocking over plant stands and throwing debris in May at a kosher bagel shop on Union Turnpike that displayed Israeli flags.

items.headline: Brick shatters Upper East Side bank window; NYPD probes bias angle
items.blurb: A brick smashed a window at the Capital One branch at 247 East 86th Street, and red graffiti on the doors led police to investigate a possible hate crime.

items.headline: Woman beaten and robbed on Central Park's East Drive; three suspects sought
items.blurb: A 32-year-old woman was struck repeatedly and robbed near 90th Street on the park's East Drive. Police are looking for three suspects; no arrests have been made.

items.headline: Robber pistol-whips and assaults 19-year-old worker at Bricktown Centre
items.blurb: A robber struck a 19-year-old employee in the face with a gun and sexually assaulted her at a store at 165 Bricktown Way, police said.

items.headline: Contractor pleads guilty after 10 drywall workers go unpaid on UWS job
items.blurb: KEP Construction LLC pleaded guilty after prosecutors said it was paid more than $1.3 million for work on a West 96th Street high-rise while 10 immigrant workers went unpaid.

items.headline: Man, 54, wounded in shooting outside Maria Hernandez Park
items.blurb: A 54-year-old man was shot and wounded outside Maria Hernandez Park in Bushwick, police said.

items.headline: Dyker Heights mother and two children reported missing
items.blurb: The NYPD is asking for help finding a Dyker Heights mother and her two children who have been reported missing.

items.headline: NYPD hunts two suspects in Lower Manhattan robbery pattern
items.blurb: Police are seeking two suspects linked to a string of robberies in Lower Manhattan and asked the public for tips.

items.headline: Canarsie man, 67, beaten from behind and robbed of phone and iPad
items.blurb: A 67-year-old man was attacked from behind near East 101st Street and Avenue J on Monday and robbed of his phone and iPad. The attacker ran off.

items.headline: Williamsbridge woman, 27, has phone snatched from pocket
items.blurb: A man came up behind a 27-year-old woman near Capuchin Way and East Gun Hill Road, took her phone from her pocket and ran, police said.

items.headline: Man, 46, killed in hit-and-run on Pitkin Avenue in East New York
items.blurb: A driver struck a 46-year-old man lying in the roadway near Chestnut Street about 1 a.m. Sunday and drove off. The man died at Brookdale University Hospital.

items.headline: Bronx senior accused of shooting girlfriend, 70, and man, 60, then barricading himself
items.blurb: An older man shot his 70-year-old girlfriend and a 60-year-old man in a Claremont building hallway, then barricaded himself, in what sources described as the end of an apparent love triangle.

items.headline: Officer struck by SUV on loud-music call in Hunts Point; driver at large
items.blurb: A police officer responding to a loud-music complaint in Hunts Point was hit by an SUV whose driver fled.

items.headline: Indicted deed-theft suspect now says her own home was stolen
items.blurb: A 69-year-old Manhattan woman indicted over the home of a dying Kew Gardens Hills widow now claims an alleged co-conspirator also took her Flushing property.

items.headline: Cyclist, 36, stabbed on East 98th Street in East Harlem
items.blurb: A 36-year-old man riding a bicycle was stabbed once in the torso on Oct. 12 in front of 138 East 98th Street. Police have announced no arrest.

items.headline: Man shot dead on Midtown subway platform; masked gunman sought
items.blurb: A 26-year-old Bronx man was fatally shot in the chest during an argument on an E train platform at the Seventh Avenue station Saturday afternoon. Police are searching for a masked gunman and have stepped up patrols in Midtown stations.

items.headline: Astoria man, 42, shot in leg as gunfire erupts on Steinway Street
items.blurb: A 42-year-old man was shot in the leg near a bench on Steinway Street on Saturday morning. Witnesses told police a white SUV sped off.

items.headline: Man, 78, stabbed on Delancey Place in Van Nest
items.blurb: A 78-year-old man was stabbed once in the abdomen outside 1822 Delancey Place and is expected to recover, investigators said. No arrest has been reported.

items.headline: Five men sought after man stabbed outside University Avenue building
items.blurb: A 35-year-old man was stabbed in the back and slashed on the hand late Thursday outside 2274 University Ave. He is expected to recover. Police are looking for at least five men.

items.headline: South Richmond Hill mother charged with murder in death of 5-year-old daughter
items.blurb: A 32-year-old woman was charged with murder after her 5-year-old daughter died at home Oct. 14. Prosecutors cite autopsy findings associated with asphyxia; she was held without bail.

items.headline: Suspicious powder mailed to Rep. Ritchie Torres' Bronx office
items.blurb: Aides at Rep. Ritchie Torres' Bronx district office were exposed to a suspicious powder sent by mail, the latest in a string of mail scares aimed at New York Democrats. The FBI is investigating.

items.headline: New charges filed in FIT student's fentanyl death
items.blurb: Prosecutors announced new charges in the March fentanyl death of a Fashion Institute of Technology student.

items.headline: Subway slasher cuts woman's arm at 145th Street station
items.blurb: Police are hunting a man who slashed a 21-year-old woman's arm during an argument at the 145th Street subway station in Harlem.

items.headline: Man stabbed in abdomen and robbed of cellphone near 37th Avenue
items.blurb: A man was stabbed in the stomach and robbed of his phone near 37th Avenue in Queens, police said.

items.headline: Man wounded in daytime shooting near Brooklyn apartment building
items.blurb: A man was shot and wounded in a daytime attack near an apartment building in Brooklyn, police said.

items.headline: Man stabbed after argument on 6 train near Astor Place
items.blurb: A man was stabbed following an argument aboard a 6 train in the East Village, and police were searching for a masked suspect.

items.headline: Nearby shooting puts Bed-Stuy school in shelter-in-place
items.blurb: A shooting near a Bedford-Stuyvesant school led officials to order a shelter-in-place, News 12 reported.

items.headline: 24-year-old stabbed on 2 train platform at East 180th Street station
items.blurb: A 24-year-old man was stabbed Tuesday night on the northbound 2 train platform at the East 180th Street station. He was hospitalized in stable condition; no arrests had been made.

items.headline: Teen, 15, slashed in head during melee in Flushing Meadows Corona Park
items.blurb: Police answering a shots-fired call near the New York Hall of Science on Oct. 12 found a disorderly group; a 15-year-old boy had been slashed across the head and arm. Police are seeking both a gunman and a slasher.

items.headline: Far Rockaway teen faces 25 to life in killing of 14-year-old in Arverne
items.blurb: A 17-year-old was charged with second-degree murder, accused of shooting a 14-year-old boy twice in the courtyard of the Ocean Bay Apartments on Sept. 21. The boy died after emergency surgery.

items.headline: Sunset Park federal jail officer indicted in contraband bribery scheme
items.blurb: A federal corrections officer at the Brooklyn jail in Sunset Park was indicted on charges of taking bribes to smuggle contraband.

items.headline: 12-year-old girl shot twice near Westchester Square park; two men sought
items.blurb: A 12-year-old girl was struck twice by gunfire near Westchester Square Park in the Bronx. Police are looking for two men.

items.headline: Rider slashed during argument on 4 train at Grand Central
items.blurb: A man was violently slashed during a dispute aboard a 4 train at Grand Central, and police were seeking the attacker.

items.headline: Ex-boyfriend charged after young mother pushed from Bronx balcony
items.blurb: A man was charged with pushing his ex-girlfriend, a young mother, from a 15th-floor balcony to her death; her baby was critically hurt. Neighbors held a vigil for her.

items.headline: Teen arrested in armed Flushing home invasion; three accomplices at large
items.blurb: Four masked men forced their way into a home near the Horace Harding Expressway and 150th Street around 2:30 a.m. Oct. 11; three showed guns and one beat a 45-year-old man with a crowbar before they fled with his watch and chain. A 17-year-old was arrested nearby; three remain at large.

items.headline: Queens man charged in fatal beating at Chelsea sex shop
items.blurb: A Queens man was charged with murder after police said he beat another man to death during an argument inside a Chelsea adult store.

items.headline: Flushing man charged with manslaughter in DUI crash that killed baby in stroller
items.blurb: Queens prosecutors charged a Flushing man with manslaughter, saying he was driving under the influence of drugs when he struck and killed a baby in a stroller.

items.headline: Pedestrian fighting for his life after Queens hit-and-run
items.blurb: A pedestrian was left in critical condition after a driver struck him and fled in Queens, police said.

items.headline: Two slashed on Beach 54th Street; suspect barricades himself as officer fires
items.blurb: Police say a 52-year-old man slashed a man and a woman at a Beach 54th Street apartment building just before midnight, then barricaded himself inside. An officer fired during the response but hit no one; the victims are expected to recover and the suspect was taken into custody and later held without bail.

items.headline: Stapleton man accused of booting neighbor's Jeep, found with stun gun
items.blurb: Police say a Stapleton man clamped a boot on a neighbor's Jeep blocking his Waverly Place driveway and demanded $25 to remove it; officers then found a stun gun on him.

items.headline: Teen stabbed and beaten with bat near Brooklyn high school
items.blurb: A teenager was stabbed and beaten with a baseball bat near a Brooklyn high school. Police are looking for five suspects.

items.headline: Queens man charged with sex abuse of 12-year-old girl; police seek more victims
items.blurb: A Queens man was charged with sexually abusing a 12-year-old girl, and police said he may have other victims and asked anyone with information to come forward.

items.headline: Teen shot dead at Harlem public housing complex; person of interest questioned
items.blurb: Police questioned a person of interest in the killing of a teenager at a Harlem public housing complex.

items.headline: Victim identified in fatal Mount Eden stabbing
items.blurb: Police identified the man killed in a fatal stabbing in the Mount Eden section of the Bronx.

items.headline: Federal immigration agents shoot and wound man in Marble Hill
items.blurb: ICE agents fired seven shots and wounded a man in Marble Hill, prompting outrage from neighbors and local officials.

items.headline: Bronx man accused of stabbing homeless man to death in Jamaica park
items.blurb: Police say a Bronx man fatally stabbed a homeless man in Major Mark Park in Jamaica.

items.headline: Queens student arrested after bringing gun to high school
items.blurb: A Queens high school student was arrested after police found a handgun in his backpack.

items.headline: Ex-Midtown attorney faces more charges in rape and torture case
items.blurb: Former Midtown attorney Ryan Hemphill faces additional charges in what prosecutors describe as a seven-hour rape and torture spree.

items.headline: Bronx man dies of stab wounds as woman tries to save him
items.blurb: A man was fatally stabbed in the Bronx while a woman tried to help him, police said.

items.headline: Bronx woman dies after being found with severe injuries in apartment
items.blurb: A woman found with severe trauma inside a Bronx apartment died, and police opened an investigation.

items.headline: Hit-and-run driver sought after Brooklyn chain-reaction crash
items.blurb: Police are searching for a driver who fled after setting off a chain-reaction crash in Brooklyn.

items.headline: Man sought for slashing 13-year-old boy outside Queens mall
items.blurb: Police are looking for a man who slashed a 13-year-old boy in the face during a dispute outside a Queens mall.

items.headline: Passenger killed in apparent DWI crash on Grand Central Parkway
items.blurb: A passenger died in a crash on the Grand Central Parkway that police believe involved a drunk driver.

items.headline: Two men beaten with hammer outside Brooklyn Burger King
items.blurb: Two men were attacked with a hammer outside a Burger King in Brooklyn, police said.

items.headline: Man stabbed after argument on Prospect Avenue; attacker fled on foot
items.blurb: A man was stabbed once in the torso after an argument near 2000 Prospect Ave. on Sept. 25 and taken to St. Barnabas Hospital in stable condition. Police released images seeking the attacker, who fled on foot.

items.headline: Man, 29, fatally stabbed outside Jamaica Avenue nightclub
items.blurb: A 29-year-old man was stabbed to death just before 1 a.m. outside Seduction Restaurant and Bar at 173-12 Jamaica Ave. No arrests have been made.

items.headline: Off-duty NYPD detective stabbed in attempted robbery in Norwood
items.blurb: An off-duty NYPD detective was stabbed during a robbery in the Norwood section of the Bronx. Two men later caught hiding in a Massachusetts basement pleaded not guilty Oct. 14.

items.headline: Bronx man found stabbed to death in his kitchen
items.blurb: A Bronx man was found stabbed to death in the kitchen of his home, police said.

items.headline: Bronx man charged with murder in random J train stabbing
items.blurb: Queens prosecutors charged a Bronx man with murder in the unprovoked stabbing of a 59-year-old Corona father of four aboard a J train at the Woodhaven Boulevard station.

items.headline: Man stabbed multiple times on the Upper West Side
items.blurb: A man was stabbed several times on the Upper West Side, police said.

items.headline: Bloodied man leaps from Queens rooftop after woman found stabbed in his apartment
items.blurb: Police found a woman stabbed inside a Queens apartment, and the bloodied man who lived there jumped from the building's roof.

items.headline: Bronx motorcyclist badly hurt; driver arrested on DWI charge
items.blurb: A motorcyclist was seriously injured in a Bronx crash, and the other driver was arrested for allegedly driving while intoxicated.

items.headline: Police seek attacker who punched 72-year-old man in the Bronx
items.blurb: Police released a description of a suspect who punched a 72-year-old man in the Bronx.

items.headline: Top-hat-wearing suspect sought in stabbing of three men on Lower East Side
items.blurb: Police are hunting a suspect seen wearing a top hat who stabbed three men on the Lower East Side.

items.headline: Man found stabbed in back and torso in bloody Bronx apartment
items.blurb: A man was found inside a Bronx apartment with stab wounds to his back and torso.

items.headline: Man charged with murdering woman in Central Park
items.blurb: The NYPD said a man has been charged with murder in the killing of a woman in Central Park.

items.headline: Three men sentenced for Harlem gang killing
items.blurb: Three men convicted in a gang assault that killed a man in Harlem were sentenced to long prison terms.

items.headline: Woman sought for strangling rider on Bronx bus
items.blurb: Police are looking for a woman who choked a fellow passenger aboard a Bronx bus.

items.headline: Man fighting for his life after being shot in the head in Brooklyn
items.blurb: A man was critically wounded by a gunshot to the head in Brooklyn, police said.

items.headline: Man dies after being dropped off at Elmhurst Hospital under suspicious circumstances
items.blurb: A man died after being left at Elmhurst Hospital in circumstances police called suspicious.

items.headline: Washington Heights shelter resident charged in fatal stabbing
items.blurb: A resident of a Washington Heights homeless shelter was charged in a deadly stabbing.

items.headline: Homeless man charged with fatally beating woman near Central Park Boathouse
items.blurb: Police charged a homeless man with murder in the beating death of a woman near the Central Park Boathouse.

items.headline: Man shot dead outside Queens strip club in apparent robbery
items.blurb: A man was shot to death outside a Queens strip club in what police believe was a robbery. Detectives are seeking the gunman.

items.headline: Man shot dead in Downtown Brooklyn park identified; two suspects at large
items.blurb: Police identified a 24-year-old man shot to death in a Downtown Brooklyn park. Two suspects remain at large.

items.headline: Teen shot dead in Queens; gunman fled on victim's own scooter
items.blurb: A teenager was fatally shot in Queens, and sources said the suspect escaped on the victim's scooter.

items.headline: Mother and son shot inside Bronx laundromat
items.blurb: A woman and her son were wounded by gunfire inside a Bronx laundromat, police said.

items.headline: Man beaten and slashed in unprovoked Bronx attack
items.blurb: A man was beaten and slashed in a random attack in the Bronx, police said.

items.headline: 14-year-old fighting for his life after Arverne shooting
items.blurb: A 14-year-old boy was shot twice in the courtyard of the Ocean Bay Apartments in Arverne and critically wounded. He later died, and a 17-year-old has been charged with murder.
